items.title: 9.2 Acids aur bases ka Lewis tasawwur (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.2, printed page 191.

blocks.text: 1923 mein G. N. Lewis ne acid-base bartao ki aam tareef pesh ki jis mein acids aur bases ki pehchan electron ka jora (pair) qubool karne ya dene aur coordinate covalent bond banane ki salahiyat se hoti hai.

blocks.title: Lewis acid aur base
blocks.text: Lewis acid koi bhi species (molecule ya ion) hai jo electron ka jora qubool kar sake, aur Lewis base koi bhi species jo electron ka jora de sake. Lewis acid-base reaction tab hota hai jab base acid ko electron ka jora deta hai.

Silver ion ke ammonia ke saath reaction mein do ammonia molecules (Lewis bases) mein se har ek musbat charge wale silver ion (Lewis acid) ko ek electron pair deta hai, adduct [H3N-Ag-NH3]+ banate hue. Baen taraf charges ka majmooa +1 hai, to daen taraf acid-base adduct ka charge bhi +1 hona chahiye.

Boron trifluoride BF3 mein boron atom ke valence shell mein sirf chhe electrons hain. Na-mukammal octet ke saath yeh electron-pair qubool karne wala banta hai, to BF3 bohat achha Lewis acid hai aur bohat se Lewis bases se react karta hai. Fluoride ion base ke taur par apna ek lone pair de to adduct BF4- banta hai; baen taraf charges ka majmooa -1 hai, to adduct ka charge bhi -1.

blocks.prompt: SO3 aur O2-, HCl aur H2O, aur BF3 aur NH3 ke reactions mein Lewis acid aur Lewis base pehchanein, muadle likhte hue (Quick Check 9.1b).
blocks.explanation: SO3 + O2- se SO4 2-: oxide ion sulfur ko jora deta hai, to O2- base aur SO3 acid. HCl + H2O se H3O+ + Cl-: pani ka oxygen lone pair proton se jurta hai, to H2O base aur HCl (apne H+ ke zariye) acid. BF3 + NH3 se H3N-BF3: nitrogen ka lone pair boron ka na-mukammal octet bharta hai, to NH3 base aur BF3 acid.

items: Lewis (1923): acid = electron-pair qubool karne wala, base = electron-pair dene wala; diya gaya jora adduct mein coordinate covalent bond banata hai.
Ag+ do NH3 ke saath [Ag(NH3)2]+ deta hai; BF3, boron par sirf chhe valence electrons ke saath, F- se jora le kar BF4- deta hai; adduct ka charge reactants ke charges ka majmooa hai.
